name: Huisu Yicun
source:
Many years ago, the popular high-school student Ann Sakura went missing in mysterious circumstances. Despite her uncountable efforts to find her, Ran Ibuki never lost the hope of holding the girl in her arms once again. Now, an old and dilapidated school in the middle of the forest is giving her that chance, but not at a low cost…

In The Chrono Jotter, Ran will find herself trapped in a chilling game of death and life as she fights to bring Ann back. The students in the school used to be slaughtered and, still, no one knows the identity of the murderer! To get out alive, Ran will be forced to solve this mystery. Fortunately, this place seems to have awakened a very convenient power within Ibuki: now, she’s able to go back in time every time someone dies.

Follow Ran in her travels to the past and help her find out the truth by gathering decisive clues. But what’s more important: don’t let anyone know about your little secret — after all, the one who slaughters can also tremble like a victim.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1398740/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
许多年前，受欢迎的高中生佐仓杏神秘失踪。尽管伊吹兰付出了无数的努力来寻找她，但她从未放弃再次将女孩抱在怀里的希望。现在，森林深处一所破旧的学校给了她这个机会，但代价不菲……

在《时空笔记本》中，兰努力救回安，发现自己陷入了一场令人毛骨悚然的生死游戏。学校里的学生曾经被屠杀过，但至今无人知道凶手的身份！为了活着出去，兰必须解开这个谜团。幸运的是，这个地方似乎唤醒了伊吹体内一种非常方便的力量：现在，每次有人死亡时，她都可以回到过去。

跟随小兰穿越到过去，收集决定性的线索，帮助她找出真相。但更重要的是：不要让任何人知道你的小秘密——毕竟，屠杀者也会像受害者一样颤抖。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1398740/]Steam[/url]]
